cards.text:
凯恩之刃
杀戮小队
原型：见背面
特工
↘ 1 名凯恩之刃特工，从以下列表中选择：
• 凶暴复仇者神官，装备有以下一种选项：
○ 星镖枪; 双拳
○ 双联星镖枪;枪托
或者从以下选项中各选择一件装备：
○ 凶暴之剑或动力武器
○ 星镖手枪或微光护盾
• 狂嚎女妖神官，装备有以下一种选项：
○ 镜像双剑
○ 星镖手枪; 处刑长戟
○ 星镖手枪; 动力武器
○ 三刃飞镖; 动力武器
○ 三刃飞镖; 星镖手枪
请继续阅读背面规则
cards.text_en:
BLADES OF KHAINE
KILL TEAM
ARCHETYPES: SEE REVERSE
OPERATIVES

from the following list:
• DIRE AVENGER EXARCH with one of the

○ Shuriken catapult; fists
○ Twin shuriken catapult; gun butts
Or one option from each of the following:
○ Diresword or power weapon
○ Shuriken pistol or shimmershield
• HOWLING BANSHEE EXARCH with one of
the following options:
○ Mirrorswords
○ Shuriken pistol; executioner
○ Shuriken pistol; power weapon
○ Shuriken pistol; triskele
○ Triskele; power weapon

原型
搜索与摧毁，或者是与己方杀戮小队中最常见的
支派关键词所关联的原型（如果有两个关键词同
样常见，那么您可以选择其中一个关键词)。支
派关键词和它们关联的原型如下：
• 凶暴复仇者：安全保护
• 狂嚎女妖：侦察
• 突击战蝎：渗透
cards.text_en:
• STRIKING SCORPION EXARCH with one of
the following options:
○ Shuriken pistol; biting blade
○ Shuriken pistol; scorpion’s claw
and chainsword
○ Twin shuriken pistols; twin chainswords
↘ 7 BLADES OF KHAINE operatives selected
from the following list:
• DIRE AVENGER WARRIOR
• HOWLING BANSHEE WARRIOR
• STRIKING SCORPION WARRIOR
ARCHETYPES
Seek & Destroy, or the associated archetype of
the most common Aspect keyword in your kill
team (if two keywords are equally most common,
you can choose one of those keywords). Aspect
keywords and their associated archetypes are
as follows:
• DIRE AVENGER: Security
• HOWLING BANSHEE: Recon
• STRIKING SCORPION: Infiltration

cards.text:
凯恩之刃
阵营规则
支派技艺
支派武士们经受了各种杀戮技巧、格挡攻击以
及灵活移动的训练。对他们的对手而言，这些
战士们的身手不仅令人惊叹也十分致命。
每一个支派技艺都属于一种类型：凶暴复仇者、
狂嚎女妖，以及突击战蝎。每一个支派技艺都只
能被拥有对应支派关键词的己方特工使用，并且
每一个技艺都会明确规定使用的时机和效果。
此外：
• 您在每一次激活或反应期间不能使用超过一个
支派技艺。
• 您在每个转折点中使用每个支派技艺的次数不
能超过一次。
• 如果每一名被选择部署的己方凯恩之刃特工
都拥有相同的支派关键词（例如突击战蝎），
那么您在每个转折点中使用每个支派技艺的次
数不能超过两次（而不是一次)。
支派技艺选项将在单独的卡片上分别进行表示
cards.text_en:
BLADES OF KHAINE
FACTION RULE
ASPECT TECHNIQUES
Aspect Warriors are trained in myriad killing techniques,
parrying blows and acrobatic movements. These are as
breathtaking to behold as they are lethal to their foes.
Each ASPECT TECHNIQUE is in a category: Dire
Avenger, Howling Banshee and Striking Scorpion.
Each ASPECT TECHNIQUE can only be used with
a friendly operative that has the matching Aspect
keyword, and each will specify when it can be
used and what its effects are. In addition:
• You cannot use more than one ASPECT
TECHNIQUE per activation or counteraction.
• You cannot use each ASPECT TECHNIQUE
more than once per turning point.
• If every friendly BLADES OF KHAINE operative
selected for deployment has the same Aspect
keyword (e.g. STRIKING SCORPION), you
cannot use each ASPECT TECHNIQUE more
than twice per turning point (instead of once).
ASPECT TECHNIQUE OPTIONS ARE PRESENTED
ON THEIR OWN CARDS

cards.text:
凯恩之刃
阵营规则
狂嚎女妖
支派技艺
灾难
狂嚎女妖是灾难的化身。他们的头盔能够释
放出超音波尖啸，将敌人眩晕后发起突击，
在敌人能够反击之前以极快的速度将他们砍
倒。
在一名己方狂嚎女妖特工的激活期间，如果该特
工执行了冲锋行动并通过近战行动将敌方特工残
废，且控制范围内不存在任何敌方特工，那么您
可以使用本支派技艺。该己方特工可以立即使用
第一次冲锋行动所剩余的移动距离来执行一次无
消耗的冲锋行动。该己方特工可以在激活期间执
行两次冲锋行动来达成上述的效果。该特工在这
次激活期间不能已执行任何其他行动（但在结算
该支派技艺后可以这么做）。
cards.text_en:
BLADES OF KHAINE
FACTION RULE
HOWLING BANSHEE
ASPECT TECHNIQUE
THE WOE
Howling Banshees are woe given form. Emitting sonic
screeches from their helms, they hurl themselves into
the stunned foe, the lightning speed of their swordplay
cutting through the enemy before a blow can be landed
in return.
Use this ASPECT TECHNIQUE during a friendly
HOWLING BANSHEE operative’s activation,
after it’s performed the Charge action and
incapacitated an enemy operative during the
Fight action, and is no longer within control range
of enemy operatives. That friendly operative can
immediately perform a free Charge action using
any remaining move distance it had from that
first Charge action. That operative can perform
two Charge actions during its activation to do so.
The operative cannot have performed any other
actions during this activation (but can do so after
resolving this ASPECT TECHNIQUE).

cards.text:
凯恩之刃
阵营规则
狂嚎女妖
支派技艺
泪雨
狂嚎女妖们以惊人的速度与敏捷冲入战斗，
在这种猛烈突袭中存活下来的少数幸存者也
几乎不可能有机会反击。
当一名己方狂嚎女妖特工进行近战时，在您使用
一次关键成功出击后，如果敌方特工没有被残
废，使用本支派技艺。结束那次流程（将任何剩
余的攻击骰舍弃)，随后使用那名特工立即执行
一次距离最多 3" 的无消耗后撤行动（之后近战
行动结束）。就算那名特工执行了阻止其执行后
撤行动的行动也可以这么做。
cards.text_en:
BLADES OF KHAINE
FACTION RULE
HOWLING BANSHEE
ASPECT TECHNIQUE
RAIN OF TEARS
Howling Banshees dive in and out of combat with
infuriating speed and agility, making it almost
impossible for those few who survive their most brutal
attacks to strike in return.
Use this ASPECT TECHNIQUE when a friendly
HOWLING BANSHEE operative is fighting, after
you strike with a critical success, if the enemy
operative isn’t incapacitated. End that sequence
(any remaining attack dice are discarded) and
immediately perform a free Fall Back action
up to 3" with that operative (then the Fight
action ends). That operative can do so even if
it’s performed an action that prevents it from
performing the Fall Back action.

cards.text:
凯恩之刃
阵营规则
狂嚎女妖
支派技艺
特技
在狂嚎女妖穿梭于战场时，没有什么能够减
缓他们的速度。这些战士们能够毫不费力地
优雅翻越或跳过面前的障碍物，并以完美的
架势和平衡性落地，然后立刻攻击敌人。
当一名己方狂嚎女妖特工执行了使其移动的行动
时使用本支派技艺。直到那次行动结束前，该
特工：
• 可以在攀爬和跳落时忽略所有垂直距离。
• 可以移动穿过敌方特工、移动进入敌方特工的
控制范围内，并且在执行冲锋行动时可以离开
敌方特工的控制范围（但是在结束那次移动后
必须遵守那次行动的所有要求)。
• 如果执行的是冲锋行动，那么不能移动超过自
身的移动属性。
cards.text_en:
BLADES OF KHAINE
FACTION RULE
HOWLING BANSHEE
ASPECT TECHNIQUE
ACROBATIC
When Howling Banshees traverse the battlefield, little
slows them down. With effortless grace they leap and
flip over intervening obstacles, landing with peerless
poise and balance to drive their blades into the foe.
Use this ASPECT TECHNIQUE when a friendly
HOWLING BANSHEE operative performs an action
in which it moves. Until the end of the action,
that operative:
• Can ignore all vertical distances whenever it
drops and climbs.
• Can move through enemy operatives, move
within control range of them, and during
the Charge action can leave their control
range (it must still end the move following all
requirements for that move).
• Cannot move more than its Move stat if it’s the
Charge action.

cards.text:
凯恩之刃
阵营规则
狂嚎女妖
支派技艺
失能尖啸
当翻腾在空中的狂嚎女妖启动了女妖面具之
时，任何敌人能够获得优势的机会都将荡然
无存。他们的感官将被过载，在无情的近战
攻击面前毫无还手的机会。
当一名己方狂嚎女妖特工进行近战或反击时，在
结算攻击骰步骤开始时使用本支派技艺。您可以
在常规顺序之前结算一次自己的成功。若这么
做，那么那次成功必须被用于格挡。
cards.text_en:
BLADES OF KHAINE
FACTION RULE
HOWLING BANSHEE
ASPECT TECHNIQUE
SCREAM-THAT-STEALS
Any hope the foe has of retaining the upper hand over a
Howling Banshee is lost the moment the leaping Aspect
Warrior activates their Banshee mask. Their senses
overwhelmed, the enemy are all but helpless against the
merciless melee attacks that follow.
Use this ASPECT TECHNIQUE when a friendly
HOWLING BANSHEE operative is fighting or
retaliating, at the start of the Resolve Attack
Dice step. You can resolve one of your successes
before the normal order. If you do, that success
must be used to block.

cards.text:
凯恩之刃
阵营规则
狂嚎女妖
支派技艺
杀戮尖叫
学会了如何正确集中自己声音的狂嚎女妖能
够释放出一种独特的尖啸，它不仅能够使敌
人致聋眩晕，也能够将他们的大脑溶解。
在一名己方狂嚎女妖特工执行射击行动时使用本
支派技艺。直到那次行动结束前，那名特工可以
使用以下远程武器：
名称攻击命中伤害
杀戮尖叫 5 3+ 1/2
武器规则
范围 6"、集中、追踪轻型、眩晕、洪流 1"
cards.text_en:
BLADES OF KHAINE
FACTION RULE
HOWLING BANSHEE
ASPECT TECHNIQUE
SHRIEK-THAT-KILLS
Those Howling Banshees who have learned how to focus
their vocal chords correctly can emit a shriek so piercing
and deafening that it can not only stun a foe, but liquefy
their brain.
Use this ASPECT TECHNIQUE when a friendly
HOWLING BANSHEE operative is performing the
Shoot action. Until the end of that action, that
operative can use the following ranged weapon:
NAME ATK HIT DMG
Shriek-that-kills 5 3+ 1/2
WR
Range 6", Saturate, Seek Light, Stun, Torrent 1"

cards.text:
凯恩之刃
阵营规则
凶暴复仇者
支派技艺
切刀飓风
凶暴复仇者被训练成为了战术极为灵活的战
士，他们能够在移动中占据领地或远离追击
的同时发射大量的星镖。
在一名己方凶暴复仇者特工执行转移行动时使用
本支派技艺。那名特工可以在那次行动期间执行
射击行动（特工必须在其能够被放置的位置执行
射击行动，并且可以在之后使用任何剩余的移动
距离)。在那次射击行动中，您必须选择使用特
工装备的星镖枪、星镖手枪或双联星镖枪。
cards.text_en:
BLADES OF KHAINE
FACTION RULE
DIRE AVENGER
ASPECT TECHNIQUE
THE SLICING HURRICANE
Trained to embrace supreme tactical flexibility,
Dire Avengers are capable of unleashing clouds of
razor-sharp shuriken while moving to secure ground or
slipping out of reach of the foe.
Use this ASPECT TECHNIQUE when a friendly
DIRE AVENGER operative is performing the
Reposition action. That operative can perform
the Shoot action during that action (it must do so
in a location it can be placed, and any remaining
move distance it had from that Reposition action
can be used after it does so). You must select its
shuriken catapult, shuriken pistol or twin shuriken
catapult for that Shoot action.

cards.text:
凯恩之刃
阵营规则
凶暴复仇者
支派技艺
千刃之死
凶暴复仇者们能够释放出单分子星镖构成的
洪流。这些致命的弹幕象征着名为千刃之死
的酷刑，是凯恩对那些不配轻易处决的叛徒
和欺诈者所赐予的惩罚。
在一名己方凶暴复仇者特工使用星镖枪或双联星
镖枪执行射击行动时使用本支派技艺。直到那次
行动结束前，那件武器拥有“洪流 2"”武器规
则，但是您不能选择超过一名次要目标。
cards.text_en:
BLADES OF KHAINE
FACTION RULE
DIRE AVENGER
ASPECT TECHNIQUE
DEATH OF A THOUSAND BLADES
Dire Avengers can unleash great deluges of
monomolecular shuriken from their weapons. These
lethal volleys echo the Death of a Thousand Blades –
the punishment that Khaine meted out upon traitors,
cheats and others he deemed unworthy of a clean kill.
Use this ASPECT TECHNIQUE when a friendly
DIRE AVENGER operative is performing the
Shoot action and you select a shuriken catapult
or twin shuriken catapult. Until the end of that
action, that weapon has the Torrent 2" weapon
rule, but you cannot select more than one
secondary target.

cards.text:
凯恩之刃
阵营规则
凶暴复仇者
支派技艺
复仇者的守望
惩罚邪恶与罪人的高尚勇士必须时刻都保持
警戒。他们必须拥有敏锐的双眼和精确的射
击能力。
在一名己方凶暴复仇者特工使用星镖枪或双联星
镖枪执行射击行动时使用本支派技艺。直到那
次行动结束前，那件武器拥有“致命 5+”武器
规则。
cards.text_en:
BLADES OF KHAINE
FACTION RULE
DIRE AVENGER
ASPECT TECHNIQUE
VIGILANCE OF THE AVENGER
The noble warrior who is tasked with punishing the
unjust and the criminal must be ever vigilant. Their eyes
must be keen and their aim must be true.
Use this ASPECT TECHNIQUE when a friendly
DIRE AVENGER operative is performing the Shoot
action and you select a shuriken catapult or twin
shuriken catapult. Until the end of that action,
that weapon has the Lethal 5+ weapon rule.

cards.text:
凯恩之刃
阵营规则
凶暴复仇者
支派技艺
灵活且坚固
凶暴复仇者装备的护甲由能耐受冲击的灵能
感应耐热鳞片制成，若其受到打击便会硬化
并将能量传遍穿戴者。在这灵活的装具上，
凶暴复仇者用类似骨头的装甲护住了最脆弱
的身体部位。
在一名特工对一名己方凶暴复仇者特工进行射击
时，如果您掷出了两次或更多失败，那么您可以
使用本支派技艺。您可以舍弃其中一次失败，将
另一枚骰子作为普通成功进行保留。
cards.text_en:
BLADES OF KHAINE
FACTION RULE
DIRE AVENGER
ASPECT TECHNIQUE
UNSTINTING, IMMOVABLE
Dire Avengers wear armour fashioned from
psycho-sensitive thermoplas scales that are reactive
to impact. When suffering a blow, the armour stiffens
to spread the energy across the wearer. On top of this
flexible suit, these Aspect Warriors wear bone-like
plates over the most vulnerable areas of their body.
Use this ASPECT TECHNIQUE when an operative
is shooting a friendly DIRE AVENGER operative,
and you’ve rolled two or more fails. You can
discard one of them to retain the other as a
normal success instead.

cards.text:
凯恩之刃
阵营规则
凶暴复仇者
支派技艺
炽热亡火
阿苏焉神殿上的灼热火焰即便日渐衰落却永
不熄灭。凶暴复仇者努力模仿这些火焰，无
论受到怎样的伤害，他们对敌人而言都极端
危险。
在一名己方凶暴复仇者特工的激活期间使用本支
派技艺。直到那名特工的下一次激活开始前，您
可以忽略任何特工因受创而导致的对属性的修正
效果（包括武器数据）。
cards.text_en:
BLADES OF KHAINE
FACTION RULE
DIRE AVENGER
ASPECT TECHNIQUE
RAGING HEAT OF THE DYING FLAME
The flames upon shrines of Asuryan possess a searing
heat and never burn out, even if they dwindle. Thus
does the Dire Avenger strive to imitate these flames,
equally dangerous to the foe regardless of the injuries
they sustain.
Use this ASPECT TECHNIQUE during a friendly
DIRE AVENGER operative’s activation. Until the
start of that operative’s next activation, you can
ignore any changes to its stats from being injured
(including its weapons’ stats).

cards.image: 11-12-阵营规则-耐心追踪，突然出手.png
cards.text:
凯恩之刃
阵营规则
突击战蝎
支派技艺
耐心追踪，突然出手
通过小心地隐匿于阴影中，突击战蝎毫无踪
迹地跟着猎物。这些支派武士在目标周围潜
行，选择发出致命一击的最佳位置。
在一名拥有隐匿命令的己方突击战蝎特工执行转
移行动时使用本支派技艺。在那次行动期间，那
名特工可以移动进入敌方特工的控制范围内(但
是不能在那里结束移动)，在结束移动后，对那
名特工移动进入过控制范围的一名敌方特工造成
D3+2 点伤害。
cards.text_en:
BLADES OF KHAINE
FACTION RULE
STRIKING SCORPION
ASPECT TECHNIQUE
PATIENT STALK, SUDDEN BLOW
Carefully concealed in cover or in shadows, Striking
Scorpions stalk their oblivious prey, manoeuvring
around their targets in complete silence to select the
optimum position to launch their killing strike.
Use this ASPECT TECHNIQUE when a friendly
STRIKING SCORPION operative that has a
Conceal order performs the Reposition action.
During that action, that operative can move
within control range of enemy operatives (it
cannot end the move there), and you can inflict
D3+2 damage on one enemy operative it moved
within control range of after it’s moved.

cards.text:
凯恩之刃
阵营规则
突击战蝎
支派技艺
突击并消匿
作为一击脱离的大师，突击战蝎会在突然袭
击后立即脱离战斗，如同凶残的幽灵一般消
失于阴影中。
当一名己方突击战蝎特工在近战或反击期间将敌
方特工残废时，如果那名特工不再位于任何敌方
特工的 3" 内，那么您可以使用本支派技艺。将
那名己方特工的命令转变为隐匿命令，并且那名
特工可以立即执行一次无消耗的冲刺行动，就算
特工执行了阻止其执行冲刺行动的行动。
cards.text_en:
BLADES OF KHAINE
FACTION RULE
STRIKING SCORPION
ASPECT TECHNIQUE
STRIKE AND FADE
Masters of the hit and run attack, Striking Scorpions
withdraw from combat as suddenly as they strike,
disappearing into shadow like murderous spirits.
Use this ASPECT TECHNIQUE when a friendly
STRIKING SCORPION operative incapacitates
an enemy operative while fighting or retaliating,
and is no longer within 3" of enemy operatives.
Change that friendly operative’s order to Conceal
and it can immediately perform a free Dash
action, even if it’s performed an action that
prevents it from performing the Dash action.

cards.text:
凯恩之刃
阵营规则
突击战蝎
支派技艺
战蝎之眼
突击战蝎星镖手枪中的取景器通过灵能连接
着持有者。通过这个设备，支派武士可以借
助多个光谱来迅速识别敌友。
在一名己方突击战蝎特工选择使用星镖手枪执行
射击行动时使用本支派技艺。直到那次行动结束
前，那件武器拥有“追踪轻型”武器规则。
cards.text_en:
BLADES OF KHAINE
FACTION RULE
STRIKING SCORPION
ASPECT TECHNIQUE
SCORPION’S EYE
A Striking Scorpion’s shuriken pistol has a viewfinder
psychically linked to its bearer. With it, the Aspect
Warrior can see through multiple spectra as well as
swiftly identify friend from foe.
Use this ASPECT TECHNIQUE when a friendly
STRIKING SCORPION operative is performing the
Shoot action and you select a shuriken pistol.
Until the end of that action, that weapon has the
Seek Light weapon rule.

cards.text:
凯恩之刃
阵营规则
突击战蝎
支派技艺
无情突击
当突击战蝎发动突袭时，他们的进攻极为无
情，一击之后接着另一击，使敌人应接不
暇，难以招架。
在一名己方突击战蝎特工进行近战时，当您在那
次流程中首次使用关键成功出击时使用本支派技
艺。直到那次流程结束前，那名特工的近战武器
拥有“震荡”武器规则。
cards.text_en:
BLADES OF KHAINE
FACTION RULE
STRIKING SCORPION
ASPECT TECHNIQUE
MERCILESS STRIKES
When Striking Scorpions launch their assault, they
attack with relentless ferocity, landing blow after blow
to grant the enemy no moment or reprieve.
Use this ASPECT TECHNIQUE when a friendly
STRIKING SCORPION operative is fighting, the
first time you strike with a critical success during
that sequence. Until the end of that sequence,
that operative’s melee weapon has the Shock
weapon rule.

cards.text:
凯恩之刃
阵营规则
突击战蝎
支派技艺
伴影之裔
经过多年的严格训练，突击战蝎能够不可思
议地融入暗影，并以惊人的精准度攻击毫无
防备的敌人。
在一名己方突击战蝎特工的激活期间使用本支派
技艺。直到那名特工的下一次激活开始前，如果
那名特工拥有隐匿命令和掩护，那么那名特工不
能被选择成为有效目标，本规则的优先度高于所
有其他规则（例如‘追踪’武器规则和制高点地
形）除非攻击者位于其 2" 内。
cards.text_en:
BLADES OF KHAINE
FACTION RULE
STRIKING SCORPION
ASPECT TECHNIQUE
ONE WITH THE GLOOM
Years of strict training render Striking Scorpions capable
of blending uncannily with the shadows, waiting for the
perfect moment to attack their unsuspecting foes with
terrifying accuracy.
Use this ASPECT TECHNIQUE during a friendly
STRIKING SCORPION operative’s activation. Until
the start of its next activation, while that operative
has a Conceal order and is in cover, it cannot be
selected as a valid target, taking precedence over
all other rules (e.g. Seek, Vantage terrain) except
being within 2".

cards.text:
凯恩之刃
标识/指示物指南
灵骨护身符守护符文预知符文
指示物指示物指示物
cards.text_en:
BLADES OF KHAINE
MARKER/TOKEN GUIDE
Wraithbone Rune of Rune of
Talisman token Shielding token Prophecy
token

cards.text:
凯恩之刃
战略计谋
预警
支派武士会在方舟世界先知的预知能力协助
之下前往战斗。
每当一名特工对就绪的己方凯恩之刃特工进行
射击时，您可以重掷任意为同一个结果的防御骰
（如结果为 2）。
cards.text_en:
BLADES OF KHAINE
STRATEGY PLOY
FOREWARNED
Aspect Warriors go to battle armed with the foresight of
their Craftworld’s seers.
Whenever an operative is shooting a ready
friendly BLADES OF KHAINE operative, you can
re-roll any of your defence dice results of one
result (e.g. results of 2).

cards.text:
凯恩之刃
战略计谋
无情冷静
上百年的战斗经验与极速的反应力和优雅的
身手结合，让支派武士变得无比危险。
每当一名己方凯恩之刃特工对一名就绪的敌方
特工进行近战时，那名己方特工的近战武器拥
有“无休”武器规则。
cards.text_en:
BLADES OF KHAINE
STRATEGY PLOY
RUTHLESS POISE
Centuries of combat experience coupled with lightning
reactions and exceptional grace render Aspect Warriors
utterly lethal.
Whenever a friendly BLADES OF KHAINE
operative is fighting a ready enemy operative,
that friendly operative’s melee weapons have the
Ceaseless weapon rule.

cards.text:
凯恩之刃
战略计谋
凯恩的复仇
支派武士会效仿血手之神的无情暴行来消灭
面前的敌人。
每当一名己方凯恩之刃特工对一名处于待机的
敌方特工进行射击时，那名己方特工的远程武器
拥有“无休”武器规则。
cards.text_en:
BLADES OF KHAINE
STRATEGY PLOY
KHAINE’S VENGEANCE
The Aspect Warriors draw upon the Bloody-Handed
God’s merciless example to dispatch their foes.
Whenever a friendly BLADES OF KHAINE
operative is shooting an expended enemy
operative, that friendly operative’s ranged
weapons have the Ceaseless weapon rule.

cards.text:
凯恩之刃
战略计谋
死亡之舞
纤细、灵敏且极为致命，艾达灵族的支派武
士能够毫无漏洞地交换战术位置。
选择两名位于彼此 6" 内且相互可见的己方凯恩
之刃特工。将这两名特工移出杀戮区，并将他
们部署至双方原本的位置（也就是说，交换这两
名特工的位置)。
cards.text_en:
BLADES OF KHAINE
STRATEGY PLOY
DANCE OF DEATH
Lithe, acrobatic and utterly deadly, Aeldari Aspect
Warriors exchange tactical positions with flawless grace.
Select two friendly BLADES OF KHAINE
operatives visible to and within 6" of each other.
Remove them both from the killzone and set
them back up in each other’s previous locations
(in other words, swap their positions).

cards.text:
凯恩之刃
交战计谋
刃风
支派武士以速度和精准发起进攻，他们闪闪
发光的利刃如同钢铁风暴一般切割敌人。
在一名己方凯恩之刃特工的激活期间使用本交
战计谋。在那次激活期间，那名特工可以执行两
次近战行动。
cards.text_en:
BLADES OF KHAINE
FIREFIGHT PLOY
BLADEWIND
Aspect Warriors strike with speed and precision, their
shining blades scything through the foe in a storm
of steel.
Use this firefight ploy during a friendly BLADES
OF KHAINE operative’s activation. During
that activation, that operative can perform two
Fight actions.

cards.text:
凯恩之刃
交战计谋
星陨
支派武士们通过压倒性的精准星镖射击将敌
人消灭。
在一名己方凯恩之刃特工的激活期间使用本交
战计谋。在那次激活期间，那名特工可以执行两
次射击行动。
cards.text_en:
BLADES OF KHAINE
FIREFIGHT PLOY
STARFALL
With punishing fusillades of accurate shuriken fire do
the Aspect Warriors fell their enemies.
Use this firefight ploy during a friendly BLADES
OF KHAINE operative’s activation. During
that activation, that operative can perform two
Shoot actions.

cards.text:
凯恩之刃
交战计谋
光芒消退
支派武士遁入黑暗之中，敌人除了暗影之外
没有任何可以攻击的目标。
在一名己方凯恩之刃特工的激活期间，在其执
行一次行动之前或之后使用本交战计谋。在那次
激活期间，那名特工在执行后撤行动时可以少消
耗 1AP。
cards.text_en:
BLADES OF KHAINE
FIREFIGHT PLOY
FADING LIGHT
The Aspect Warrior slips away into darkness, leaving
their foe striking at nothing but shadow.
Use this firefight ploy during a friendly BLADES
OF KHAINE operative’s activation, before or
after it performs an action. During that activation,
that operative can perform the Fall Back action
for 1 less AP.

cards.text:
凯恩之刃
交战计谋
蔑视
艾达灵族通过支派武士展现了他们一族在武
力上的优势，这些战士们能够在敌人的火力与
重击之间舞动，怀着蔑视的态度轻松躲闪。
当一名己方凯恩之刃特工进行反击，或者在一
名敌方特工进行射击时，在对手掷攻击骰后，重
掷之前使用本交战计谋。直到那次流程结束前，
您的对手不能重掷自己的攻击骰（如果您的对手
在那次流程中宣布使用任何允许他们进行重掷的
交战计谋，那么那次计谋被取消，并返还被消耗
的 CP)。
cards.text_en:
BLADES OF KHAINE
FIREFIGHT PLOY
CONTEMPT
The martial superiority of the Aeldari species is
expressed by their Aspect Warriors, who dance
through incoming fire and heavy strikes with
contemptuous ease.
Use this firefight ploy when a friendly BLADES
OF KHAINE operative is retaliating or an enemy
operative is shooting it, after your opponent rolls
their attack dice, but before re-rolls. Until the end
of the sequence, your opponent cannot re-roll
their attack dice (if your opponent declared the
use of any firefight ploys during that sequence
that would allow them to re-roll, that ploy is
cancelled and the CP spent on it is refunded).

cards.text:
凯恩之刃
阵营装备
预知符文
一名强大的先知将这种充斥着亚空间能量的
符文附在了支派武士的护甲上，它能够赐予
持有者一部分先知所拥有的预知能力。
每场战斗限一次，在拼骰决定先手权时，您可以
为您的掷骰结果添加 D3 或减少 D3。
cards.text_en:
BLADES OF KHAINE
FACTION EQUIPMENT
RUNE OF PROPHECY
Affixed to an Aspect Warrior’s armour by a powerful
seer, this warp-charged rune provides the bearer with a
sliver of its creator’s prophetic vision.
Once per battle, after rolling off to decide
initiative, you can add D3 to, or subtract D3 from,
your result.

cards.text:
凯恩之刃
阵营装备
守护符文
这种符文散发着亚空间的能量，在遭到能量
武器的冲击时会闪闪发光，抵御子弹、爆矢
和利刃的攻击。
每场战斗限一次，在一枚攻击骰对一名己方凯恩
之刃特工造成普通伤害时，您可以忽略那次造
成的伤害。
cards.text_en:
BLADES OF KHAINE
FACTION EQUIPMENT
RUNE OF SHIELDING
Shimmering with empyric energy, this rune flares
brightly when it suffers impact from an enemy weapon,
turning aside bullet, bolt or blade.
Once per battle, when an attack dice inflicts
Normal Dmg on a friendly BLADES OF KHAINE
operative, you can ignore that inflicted damage.

cards.text:
凯恩之刃
阵营装备
先见符文
这件符文的持有者能够预知到未来的战斗，
并看破敌人的动向，以超凡的狡诈智慧将手
下的战士们移动至理想的位置。
在本装备被揭示后，掷一枚 D3。在相当于掷骰
结果数值的转折点中，您在战略阶段中获得额
外 1CP。
cards.text_en:
BLADES OF KHAINE
FACTION EQUIPMENT
RUNE OF FORESIGHT
The bearer foresees the battle to come, anticipating the
movements of the foe and positioning their warriors with
uncanny guile.
When this equipment is revealed, roll one D3. In
the Strategy phase of the turning point equal to
the result, you gain 1 additional CP.

cards.text:
凯恩之刃
阵营装备
灵骨护身符
这件护符由活体的灵骨材质生长而成，能够在战斗
中为佩戴者提供力量与决心。
每个转折点限一次，在一名己方凯恩之刃特工
进行射击、近战和反击时，如果您掷出了两次或
更多失败，那么您可以将其中一次失败舍弃，并
将另一次失败作为普通成功进行保留。
cards.text_en:
BLADES OF KHAINE
FACTION EQUIPMENT
WRAITHBONE TALISMAN
Grown from living wraithbone material, this talisman
lends the bearer strength and determination in the
midst of battle.
Once per turning point, when a friendly BLADES
OF KHAINE operative is shooting, fighting or
retaliating, if you roll two or more fails, you can
discard one of them to retain another as a normal
success instead.
